gate1_fixed_path_equals_original_llava.criterion: for every prompt the earlier main runs sent -- 12,183 (dialogue, turn) pairs with the generated history of each of the four methods -- the ids of the fixed path equal the ids of the original LLaVA procedure (tokenizer_image_token, slow legacy tokenizer); and the ids of the legacy path are the ids those runs recorded (so the comparison is made on the path they really used)
gate1_fixed_path_equals_original_llava.note: the main phase's own follow-up prompts depend on what each method generates there; the harness repeats this comparison after every request and stops on a mismatch, and the image audit re-derives it (reported after the main phase by --stage posthoc)

gate2_llava15_path_unchanged.criterion: LLaVA-1.5 path, 60 prompts (20 images spread over the LLaVA-1.5 x MT-GQA main run, the first dialogue's T1, T2, T3 as ReComp sent them): the prompt rebuilt by the current code and its token ids equal what that run recorded (ids after the image, number of ids before it); and every source file that run froze is byte-identical today
gate2_llava15_path_unchanged.note: equal_original_llava_ids is reported, not judged (stage 0 of the ConvBench run found 0 mismatches for LLaVA-1.5)
